newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH says will not drop DFS bid.
newsitem.headline: LVMH says will not drop DFS bid.

text.p: French luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton on Friday said it had no plans to drop a bid for 59 percent in U.S. duty-free goods group DFS Group Ltd.

In a statement to shareholders LVMH confirmed a newspaper report that U.S. investment bank Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co had sent a letter of interest to DFS shareholders, proposing to buy the company.
LVMH added that KKR's letter contained no precise figures and did not constitute a bid and the initiative was conditional upon LVMH withdrawing.
LVMH said that its deal with two DFS shareholders was firm and final and all parties intended to respect all their engagements.

It said it was the only partner capable of improving rapidly and durably DFS's sales and profits while a financial group would not bring any industrial synergy and would only be looking for short term profits.
LVMH said it would do its best to keep DFS management and preserve the identity of the company within the group.
